mentions.name: Trailbound
mentions.description: A hiking and backpacking planning tool that combines lightweight routing (a lighter version of Caltopo or GaiaGPS) with granular "leg" mapping based on off-trail trip planning, plus sharing functions that let family members know where the hiker will be, who they're with, and who to contact if they don't check in on time. Runs on a Hetzner box using Mapbox, and an iOS app is in progress to enable offline access to maps and routes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm hacking on Trailbound, a hiking and backpacking planning tool. The goal is combining a light version of the routing capability of Caltopo or GaiaGPS with more granular "leg" mapping based on how I learned to plan off trail trips and sharing functions that make it easy for my wife to know where I'm going to be, who I'm with, and who to contact if I'm not back in touch when I said I would be.
